job.job_description:
Location- PAN India

Experience- 3-12 Years

Notice Period- 0-60 Days

 

Responsibilities:

Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, including planning, design, development, testing, and deployment.
Analyze daily failures and proactively partake in corrective action and engineering change strategies.
Design and develop user interfaces (UIs) using Angular and related technologies (TypeScript, HTML, CSS).
Design and implement back-end logic for data processing, business rules, and application workflows.
Write unit and integration tests for both front-end and back-end components.
Testing and debugging of new software releases prior to their deployment to the global fleet.
Contribute to code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.

Required skills and experience:

Proven ability to build dynamic and interactive web applications using modern web development platforms (Angular / React) and in-depth knowledge of JavaScript/Typescript, CSS, HTML (preferably with portfolio),
Experience in Object-oriented programming (Python / JavaScript / C++),
Experience with scripting languages (Python, Bash),
Experience with Linux and Command Line,
Knowledge of Database Management (SQL and Non-SQL)

 

Frontend:

      React (must-have)

HTML 5/CSS 3
JavaScript/TypeScript
JSON/RESTful APIs
Modern UI/UX frameworks and component libraries
State management (Redux, Context API, or similar)

Backend:

Python (required)
FastAPI (required)
RESTful API design and development
Microservices architecture
WebSockets and async programming
